resample_unit: panoramic image, within each test fold; T_f for tooth level, I_f for image level

implementation.draws: numpy default_rng(42); for b in 1..1000, for f in F1..F5: first |T_f| integers for the tooth draw, then |I_f| integers for the image draw; §9.2/§9.3 and Deep Ensembles reuse round 1's draws (paired with slot 1)
implementation.duplicates: an image drawn k times contributes its patches k times; for image-level metrics, ICC and any grouping, each drawn copy is its own cluster
implementation.fixed_parameters: Φ, α*, T*, τ, Φ_method and the crop-area tertile cut points are held fixed (fitted on val / covariate only); the bootstrap measures test-sampling variability (§8.4)
implementation.recomputed: every metric definition of 06 is re-applied to the resample, incl. CB weights from the resampled class counts, the 3-class filter and the §7.5 #2 decile (⌊N_b/10⌋ of the pooled resample)
implementation.ci: percentile CI, numpy linear percentiles 2.5 / 97.5 of the non-dropped iterations
implementation.degenerate: NaN in an iteration (empty set, one class absent) drops it for that quantity only; > 5% of B dropped -> CI not reported
implementation.delta: ΔAURC_CV = AURC_CV(A) − AURC_CV(B) inside each iteration; negative favours A
implementation.p_value: two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2·(min(#Δ_b ≤ 0, #Δ_b ≥ 0) + 1) / (B + 1)), only for the Holm family (proposed vs the 6 §6.1 baselines); Holm step-down over those 6; reported for use only if a table-wide significance claim is made (§8.2)
implementation.icc: ICC(1) of the per-patch error indicator within images, one-way ANOVA with unequal cluster sizes, per test fold, macro-average; design effect 1 + (m−1)·ICC with m = patches per labelled image of the fold; descriptive only, never used for power (§8.1)
